Looking forward — happy to hop on a quick call if that helps.

Subject: Re: Initial scope & evidence handoff for Redwood pen test

Hi Sophie —

Attached below is the suggested evidence ops checklist for TrustLoop. This is intentionally compact so your testers can quickly find what we'll push:

*Evidence Ops Checklist (short):*
1) Authentication logs (Auth0) — CSV export, last 90 days, include timestamps and user_ids.
2) Infrastructure inventory — terraform state snapshot + AMI/image IDs.
3) Network allowlist — VPC CIDR, public ELBs, static IPs used by Redwood endpoints.
4) App config — current config repo tag + runtime flags (redactions applied).
5) Error/trace samples — up to 50 anonymized traces from the last 7 days.
6) SOC2 artifacts requested separately via the compliance portal (if needed).

Upload mechanics:
- Preferred: TrustLoop evidence portal (create folder "redwood/pen-test-2027-05" and invite k.iyer@redwood.com + security@redwood.com)
- Fallback: secure Drive link with folder-level access + audit logs enabled.

On-call contacts during active windows:
- Infra: Neha Kapoor (neha_kapoor@redwood.com)
- App: Sam Liu (sam_liu@redwood.com) — note: Sam is not on this thread, will be added when we finalize windows.

Timeline note: we'll aim to have the first evidence batch uploaded 48 hours before the active test window.

Questions for TrustLoop:
- Do you need short-lived SSH keys for deeper infra validation? If so, share the key format and rotation window.

Thanks,
Karthik
Senior Platform Engineer — Redwood Inference

From: Sophie Miller <sophie.miller@trustloop.io>
To: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>, Avery Johnson <avery.johnson@redwood.com>
Cc: security@trustloop.io, Ben Carlson <ben.carlson@redshield.io>
Date: Mon, 31 May 2027 15:24:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Initial scope & evidence handoff for Redwood pen test

Karthik, Avery —

This checklist is perfect, thank you. A few clarifications and confirmations:
- We'll use the TrustLoop evidence portal. I'll set up the folder and invite k.iyer@redwood.com + security@redwood.com by EOD.
- SSH: we prefer a 12-hour ephemeral key (public key format) for host-level verification. Please confirm if Redwood can provide that during the test window.
- Traces: anonymized samples are fine; please include the sampling method (e.g., 1-in-100 requests) in the metadata file.
- Delivery: first batch 48 hours before the window is good — we'll confirm final dates after SOW sign.

Ben (cc): per our SLA discussion, if RedShield will support vulnerability triage post-test, let's align on expected turnaround (we typically ask for 3 business days for initial remediation guidance).

Next steps:
1) TrustLoop to provision evidence folder + invites (EOD today).
2) Redwood to confirm ephemeral SSH key workflow and upload first evidence batch once folder is available.
3) Lauren to share SOW draft so procurement can complete signature.

I'll send the portal invite in a separate email thread (security-only recipients included).

Best,
Sophie
Partner Program Manager
TrustLoop
